_comment: Weather → ground overlay mapping consumed by GroundOverlayPass each frame. Values mirror the prior hardcoded if/else block in World3DRenderer.UpdateGroundEffectEase / GroundOverlayPass.UpdateGroundEffectEase (sessions 1–64). ADR-012 §3 Phase 4 pilot — pattern for the other three data-driven mappings to follow. Keys MUST match ClassicUO.Renderer.Atmosphere.WeatherKind enum names exactly. Modes MUST match ClassicUO.Renderer.Environment.GroundEffectMode names. Weather kinds not listed here produce no overlay (target intensity eased to 0, mode preserved during fade per session-64 behavior).
